Pathway-pathway network of 108 shared genes between cardiovascular disease and rheumatoid arthritis

Pathway-pathway network of 108 shared genes between cardiovascular disease and rheumatoid arthritis. Green nodes represented pathways. Red nodes, pink nodes, and blue nodes represented genes linked to at least 3 modules, at least 2 modules, and 1 modules, respectively
